## 🐞 Describe the bug
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

## 🔁 To Reproduce
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Go to '...'
2. Click on '...'
3. See error

## 🎯 Expected behavior
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

## ❌ Actual behavior
What actually happened instead.

## ✅ Acceptance Criteria
This bug will be considered fixed when:

- [ ] The issue no longer occurs when following the reproduction steps
- [ ] The expected behavior is observed consistently
- [ ] No new bugs are introduced
- [ ] Edge cases related to this bug are handled

## 🖼 Screenshots / Logs
If applicable, add screenshots, error messages, or logs to help explain the problem.

## 📎 Additional context
Add any other context about the problem here (environment, OS, browser, version, etc.).
